items.title: Website update
items.text:
The website has been updated; the following has been added:

1. A new font has been introduced across the entire website, refreshing the overall visual identity.

2. The header design has been updated and streamlined for better navigation and a more modern look.

3. New sub-sections for the label have been added, providing dedicated spaces for deeper content organization.

4. A featured announcement section has been launched for the upcoming album release by Xiroach.

5. Various other visual adjustments, under-the-hood updates, and performance improvements have been made throughout the platform.

items.title: Website update
items.text:
The website has been updated; the following has been added:

1. The navigation system has been redesigned and expanded, with clearer separation between the main sections and additional pages.

2. A new announcement section has been added to the homepage, displaying current updates and featured information.

3. The announcement section now automatically displays the latest news from the website, keeping the homepage and news section synchronized.

4. The homepage layout has been updated with a full-width announcement banner and support for image-based announcements.

5. Various visual and navigation improvements have been made throughout the website, including improved scrolling, active navigation states, spacing, and responsive behaviour.
